title: fleet-write relay: pr_create read-back prints no labels clause, so os-dev's label read-back rule cannot be met
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① tooling defect with a named producer (a rule no reader can meet from the tool's output), raised as class b by the dev of PR #32531 (#32519, report 6813508247). ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## The rule

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L302-304: the dev declares `skip-changeset` in the `pr_create` `labels`, and "the read-back of that leg is the line the relay reports: the answer must list every label sent; one missing ⇒ that stroke FAILED".

## What the relay prints

`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` `readBackLine` (L1205) appends `assigneesText(row)` (L1214) to a `pr_create` row: the assignees as the pull lists them. There is no labels counterpart, so the line never lists a label. On run 43148195152 a `pr_create` sent labels [skip-changeset]; the relay printed the body bytes and the assignees and no labels. The dev read the label off `pulls/32531` by REST instead.

## Reach

Every dev `pr_create` that carries labels: the rule as written cannot be met, so each dev either reports a FAILED stroke that did land or deviates.

## Duplicate check

Searched open issues for `readBackLine`, `assigneesText`, "read-back labels pr_create": only #32519 (the report comment itself). No open card.

Blocked-by: #32556
